flow_element_definitions.action: Real executable step in the formal flow graph.
flow_element_definitions.decision: Conditional branching point based on facts, standards, thresholds, evidence sufficiency, or compliance requirements.
flow_element_definitions.end: Local exit, stable result, or handoff point of the current card; not necessarily the end of the business matter.
flow_element_definitions.start: Local entry point of the current card; not the start of the whole customer lifecycle or textbook process.
flow_element_definitions.steps: Human-readable summary derived from flow_nodes and flow_edges; not the source of truth.
flow_element_definitions.summary: Optional human-readable card description; it does not replace flow_nodes or flow_edges.
